Was du bei uns machst
Als Lead AI Engineer führst du unser Engineering-Team, entwickelst rund drei Viertel deiner Zeit selbst mit und arbeitest eng mit unserem CTO zusammen.
Deine Schwerpunkte:
Selbst entwickeln. Du übernimmst anspruchsvolle Features und Architekturthemen in unseren Agenten-, RAG- und Workflow-Systemen und schreibst Pläne, an denen sich andere orientieren.

description:
What we do
MAIA is an AI platform for companies. With MAIA, teams search their internal data and embed agents deep into their processes. We help companies use AI not just in individual departments, but across the entire organisation.
On a technical level, this means: we build a GenAI application with our own agent systems, RAG pipelines and agent-based workflows, connect our customers' external systems and analyse their data. We use the best available models, operated in the EU, and make them reliable for demanding work with large, complex datasets.
Many industrial companies have been using MAIA intensively for years. Following our successful 2026 funding round, we are now taking MAIA to a broader market. MAIA has been developed in Leipzig since 2021.
What you'll do
As a Product Engineer, you own features from start to finish: from conversations with customers and concept work through to implementation and continuous improvement in production.

Understanding customers and the market. You talk to users, join customer meetings and analyse usage data. This way, you find out where MAIA can help most in people's daily work. You work closely with product management and customer success.

From problem to concept. You write concepts, build prototypes to test ideas quickly, and slice features so they reach users early.

description:
WHO WE ARE 
Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.
Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.
Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION
Work on a civilisation-scale problem - Clean, baseload fusion energy is one of the few genuinely world-changing challenges, and every hire in Finance, People, or Legal directly accelerates the path to a working stellarator.

Grow as fast as the company does - With headcount set to roughly 5x in a few years and major technical milestones ahead on the path to our demo machine and first power plant, your role grows under you; today's hire is tomorrow's function lead.

At Emidat, we are building the first climate-native product management system for building material manufacturers.
Emidat aims to decarbonise building materials, making up 11% of global GHG emissions. We collect data from physical production processes, generate a digital product passport with verified environmental data and make it usable along the value chain. In short: One solution to assess, design, buy, sell and manage products - with environmental impact at the core.
Embodied carbon is emitted on day zero and can never be reduced later, while global floor area is set to double by 2060. From January 2026, EU regulation (CPR) requires verified environmental data. 430,000 manufacturers will need it, and only about 2,500 have it today. That gap is our market.

Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.  

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability. 

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally. 

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers. 

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.

The Role

We are looking for someone who is curious about the domain: what the process is, where people struggle, what is worth solving and how and then solutionise what is worth building using technology. 

This is an opportunity to redefine the role of design for a world experiencing constant AI disruption. A world where human judgement, empathy, systems thinking, and creativity become the real differentiators, while AI accelerates the entire Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). 

You will work closely with CXOs, product owners, engineers and data scientists to co-own the product vision and help them craft the path forward. Within the team, you will drive ambiguity towards real, valuable outcomes through design.

You will own and shape the product direction, challenge weak assumptions and stay close to implementation. You will leverage your collective experience as a design practitioner in this entire journey for driving impact on the client side. You will craft ‘new ways of working‘ from a design perspective with the influx of AI.

We are not looking for someone whose primary focus is making requirements turned into artefacts, make things look polished or pixel-perfect.

You're comfortable across the full design lifecycle, but you're exceptional at the parts that make it land: sharp problem framing, design that ships, and AI-accelerated craft.

Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.
At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.

description:
👫  About the team

Equativ's EMEA Demand team is responsible for growing relationships with agencies, advertisers, DSPs and other demand partners across the region, helping them leverage Equativ's full suite of omnichannel advertising solutions.

As we continue to strengthen our position with the world's leading agencies, we are also increasing our engagement directly with brands - understanding their business and media challenges, and ensuring Equativ's capabilities are represented in the conversations that shape future investment.

We are looking for a Senior Director EMEA, Brand Partnerships to define and lead this strategy, reporting to our VP Demand, EMEA.

This role is about creating stronger connections between brands, their agencies and Equativ, helping us build more strategic relationships with advertisers while creating incremental opportunities for our existing agency ecosystem.

This is a highly visible, entrepreneurial role for someone who knows the European advertising industry exceptionally well, has strong relationships with senior marketers, and can build a new commercial motion from the ground up.

✍️  What you'll do

Define and lead Equativ’s EMEA Brand Partnerships strategy, identifying priority brands, verticals and markets, and building a scalable plan to strengthen Equativ’s position with advertisers across the region.

title: Product Marketing Manager - Internship / apprenticeship starting 2027
summary: 👫 About the team  It is the responsibility of our Product Marketing team to make sure that the world knows about Equativ and all of the awesome things our solutions can do. The team is composed of…
description:
👫 About the team

It is the responsibility of our Product Marketing team to make sure that the world knows about Equativ and all of the awesome things our solutions can do. The team is composed of straightforward and creative individuals shaping our brand across the globe. They are the heart of Equativ’s global awareness and play a major role in orchestrating the global launches of new innovative solutions, communicating Equativ’s value proposition to customer facing teams and ensuring product success. 

Your mission 👇

Reporting to our product marketing director in charge of supply, emerging channels and retail media, your main tasks will be:

You’ll be in charge of promoting our product and solutions by coordinating, monthly and quarterly newsletters designed in 4 languages

You’ll be in charge of coordinating the creation of our quarterly customer QBR template for our customer-facing teams.

You’ll plan and execute customer communication in the interface to announce new features and product releases.

You’ll create and update marketing collaterals: sales deck, product sheet, case studies, etc.

You will run competitive analysis to get a better understanding of market trends You’ll support the product marketing managers in launching new products. (Customer usage analysis, survey, …)

You'll write blog articles about our products and market trends

You’ll also do many other things. Our job is different everyday… market and company are growing and moving so quickly

title: Lead Data Scientist H/F
summary: Volta Medical is an innovative, data-inspired US and European-based growth MedTech aimed at creating and bringing to the market cutting-edge AI software products to revolutionize interventional…
description:
Volta Medical is an innovative, data-inspired US and European-based growth MedTech aimed at creating and bringing to the market cutting-edge AI software products to revolutionize interventional cardiac electrophysiology.  

Volta has created a data collection and enrichment ecosystem for curated EP lab data which is fed into a physician validated, machine learning methodology to support complex AF solutions. Our newest technology, Volta AF-Xplorer II, is a data-driven AI decision support system that easily integrates into the standard physician workflow, providing a patient-tailored approach to complex AF and AT procedures.  

Our dynamic, innovative team is made up of 100+ collaborators in the EU and USA from a wide variety of backgrounds including engineers, business professionals and physicians, working together to develop AI solutions that help electrophysiologists help patients.

Mission 

As Lead Data Science, you will play a key role in shaping the future of Volta's AI technology. You will lead a multidisciplinary Data Science team and contribute directly to the development of innovative machine learning solutions embedded in medical devices used daily in electrophysiology labs worldwide. 

Reporting to the VP Innovation, you will combine scientific expertise, technical leadership and people management to drive the development of next-generation AI algorithms while ensuring compliance with medical device quality and regulatory…

summary: Une nouvelle vision de la billetterie, au service du monde de la culture, des événements en direct, des loisirs et du sport.  Bienvenue chez vivenu, leader mondial de la billetterie événementielle et…
description:
Une nouvelle vision de la billetterie, au service du monde de la culture, des événements en direct, des loisirs et du sport.

Bienvenue chez vivenu, leader mondial de la billetterie événementielle et l'une des entreprises technologiques à la croissance la plus rapide au monde. Nous avons révolutionné la billetterie de sites et producteurs comme les Grammy Awards, les Golden Globes, Fondation Louis Vuitton, Fondation du Patrimoine, Le Mans FC transformant les process de billetterie et les données collectées lors des parcours de vente en avantage stratégique. Bénéficiant d’investissements à hauteur de 65 millions de dollars, vivenu permet aux organisateurs d'événements de mettre en avant leur identité, de transformer l’expérience client, et d'intégrer la billetterie de manière transparente dans leur écosystème numérique.

vivenu s’engage auprès de ses partenaires pour assurer un support d’excellence et pour répondre de façon simple à leurs enjeux en créant des expériences exceptionnelles.

Rejoignez-nous et participez à la transformation des métiers de la billetterie et du marketing.

En tant que Solution Architect, vos responsabilités comprendront:

Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des intégrations sur mesure (connexions API, systèmes d’authentification SSO, ERP, etc.) en vous appuyant sur les puissants outils proposés par vivenu.

summary: Qui sommes-nous?  Artefact est une nouvelle génération de société spécialisée dans le conseil en data et en marketing digital data-driven, dont les 2500 employés répartis sur 27 pays ont pour mission…
description:
Qui sommes-nous?

Artefact est une nouvelle génération de société spécialisée dans le conseil en data et en marketing digital data-driven, dont les 2500 employés répartis sur 27 pays ont pour mission de transformer les données de nos clients en impact business tangible.

La société est née en France en 2014 et à connu une croissance forte, sur son métier historique, le conseil data marketing, mais aussi progressivement sur tous les cas d’usages data appliqués à l’entreprise. Artefact est soutenu par des investisseurs de premier plan (Cinven), européens, et qui visent à bâtir un leader mondial dans son secteur.

Le département Digital & Data Marketing d’Artefact 

Au sein des bureaux parisiens, l’équipe Digital & Data Marketing d’Artefact France est composée de 65 consultants dont le rôle est de construire les stratégies digital marketing les plus adaptées aux enjeux de nos clients, de les déployer et d’en mesurer la performance. 

En fonction des besoins des clients, nous aurons un rôle de conseil (stratégie, diagnostic de performance, modèle opérationnel, feuille de route, …) et/ou un rôle de mise en oeuvre avec les opérations de campagne et le déploiement de mesure du ROI (attribution/incrémentalité/MMM)

Ces projets s’appuient sur une expertise complète des canaux marketing et des plateformes en Paid Social, Paid Search, Programmatique, Retail media, mais aussi sur une expertise et en plein développement du GEO.

summary: Présentation du poste :   Nous recherchons un(e) Senior Data Consultant(e) pour accompagner la transformation Data & IA de nos clients C-Level (COMEX, marketing, digital, supply-chain, opérations,…
description:
Présentation du poste : 

Nous recherchons un(e) Senior Data Consultant(e) pour accompagner la transformation Data & IA de nos clients C-Level (COMEX, marketing, digital, supply-chain, opérations, customer support, IT...). Le/la consultant(e) pilote avec une large autonomie des projets complets de bout en bout, supervisé(e) par un n+1 (manager, directeur, partner), et encadre les consultants plus juniors. 

Missions : 

Piloter un ou plusieurs streams : garantir le delivery, identifier les points de blocage, proposer des solutions, assurer la gestion de projet (documentation, planning, comptes-rendus)

Encadrer et donner des feedbacks constructifs aux membres juniors de l'équipe

Produire de manière autonome les livrables de mission : présentations, benchmarks, études de cas, workshop decks, sections steerco

Rédiger des storylines et concevoir des slides percutantes

Animer les interviews et workshops clients

Construire une relation de confiance avec les clients et identifier des opportunités business

Contribuer au développement d'Artefact : développement d'une offre, d'une industrie, d'un chapter ou d'un partenariat école ; participation au recrutement et à la formation des nouveaux arrivants

Soutenir et développer une ou plusieurs expertises internes (stratégie, data governance, data marketing...) via la construction d'offres, la formation, ou des actions marketing

Profil recherché :

2 à 3 ans d'expérience professionnelle en cabinet de conseil

title: Senior Customer Onboarding Specialist
summary: The Senior Customer Onboarding Specialist supports new customers through the Didomi onboarding cycle, from Kick-Off to deployment and handover to the Customer Success team. The role is the entry…
description:
The Senior Customer Onboarding Specialist supports new customers through the Didomi onboarding cycle, from Kick-Off to deployment and handover to the Customer Success team. The role is the entry point into the Customer Onboarding career path and is performed under the guidance of the Onboarding unit manager.

The Senior Customer Onboarding Specialist builds knowledge of the Didomi product suite and of customer privacy needs, keeps customer data up to date in Planhat, and relays customer feedback to the relevant internal teams.

Key Activities : 

Manage a defined portfolio of new customers of lower complexity (Growth Business), with a volume adapted to the learning curve. 

Run the onboarding steps with support: Pre-Kick-Off, Kick-Off, setup and follow-up calls, Go-live monitoring, Platform Demo / QA, and closure

Insurance is a numbers business, and most of those numbers are harder to trust than they look. You would lead the team that defines the numbers Insify runs on, from the event a customer fires on our website to the report a risk carrier audits months later.

About the Role

You would lead our Data & Analytics team of 3-4 engineers end to end: ingestion, the warehouse and its models, the metric layer, and the analysis and reporting built on top of it. It is a small team with a big surface, so there is nowhere to hide and nothing you can't reach.

We are deliberately not splitting data engineering from analytics. At our size the hard problems sit in the handover between the two, and we want one person who enjoys that whole puzzle.

The team serves four groups with genuinely different needs. Growth wants hourly to daily signals and can live with approximately right. Carrier reporting and corporate finance are calendar-locked and need numbers that reconcile and survive an audit months later. Actuarial needs depth and lineage over speed. Prioritising here is arbitration between things that fail in different ways, and the arbitration is yours.

It's a hands-on role. You can open the warehouse and read the models, you review a new data model before it ships, and your team trusts your technical judgement because you still use it. Innovativ höjd - grad av nyhetsvärde

Strategisk höjd - grad av framåtriktning

Värdeskapande höjd - grad av ekonomiskt, kulturellt, socialt, kvalitativt värde

Standing up the regression suite that lets us upgrade LSF on a schedule rather than on a dare.

Working alongside our LSF internals engineer to encode hard-won scheduler knowledge into templates and policy, so that expertise lives in the repository instead of in one person's head.

About the Role:

This application is for a 6-month student role from January - June 2027. Resume review begins in October 2026.

The Clinical Pharmacology & Pharmacometrics (CPP) team leverages pharmacology, quantitative modeling, and simulation to support data-driven drug development decisions. CPP generates insights into how drugs interact with the body and helps optimize dosing strategies from early research through regulatory approval and lifecycle management.

At Biogen, CPP works in a highly collaborative and flexible environment that supports a diverse portfolio of therapeutic programs. Team members partner closely with colleagues across Research, Clinical Development, Regulatory, and other functions to inform development strategy and optimize patient outcomes. While Clinical Pharmacology scientists often focus on translational and project strategy and Pharmacometrics scientists specialize in quantitative modeling, team members frequently work across disciplines to meet program needs.

This Co-op role sits within the Pharmacometrics team and offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of quantitative systems pharmacology (QSP), artificial intelligence, and model-based meta-analysis (MBMA) in the autoimmune therapeutic area. Overvågning, analyse og håndtering af security alerts og incidents

description:
Payroll that runs itself. You build the part that runs it.
quinn is an app-based managed payroll and employment-administration service for households and companies who employ people directly. The customer stays the legal employer. quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, pays salaries, social insurance and taxes, and handles every filing that follows, on their behalf and automated end to end.

We don’t sell payroll software. We run payroll.
We operate in Switzerland, Germany and the UK. Last year more than CHF 200 million in salaries ran through our systems, correct to the cent. The purpose behind it is simple: fair employment, for all.

Why this role exists
Every market brings its own authorities, insurers, pension funds and tax rules. Our answer is quinn ONE: one platform for every product and market, with a shared core for what all countries have in common and a configuration layer per country on top, designed to carry twelve countries.
The backend is that core. It is a modular monolith in C#, .NET 10 and PostgreSQL, serving one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, Maestro for batch processing, and our AI agents. Development has started, and the foundations the platform will run on for years are being laid now.
This role is fully focused on quinn ONE. Our existing products are not part of it.

About Stripe

Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the…

About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the…

Open Issuance is central to that opportunity. Built by Bridge, a Stripe company, it enables businesses to launch and manage their own stablecoins. High urgency: Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly. 

Product taste: Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge - you will often be "the PM".

Security mindset: A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.

In practice, we use boring technology like Node, React, and AWS so we can focus our engineering energy entirely on pushing the boundaries of Privy's core product, e.g. through hardware enclaves, multi-region low latency APIs, and blockchain abstractions that are accessible to mainstream developers.

About Privy

Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.

Privy owns the abstractions and infrastructure layer above wallets, integrating across chains, third-party providers, and Stripe products like Treasury and Link. About the team

Engineering at Privy is distinguished by

High urgency—Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly

Product taste—Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge—you will often be "the PM."

Security mindset—A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.

In practice, we use boring technology like Node, React, and AWS so we can focus our engineering energy entirely on pushing the boundaries of Privy's core product, e.g. through hardware enclaves, multi-region low latency APIs, and blockchain abstractions that are accessible to mainstream developers.
